mapper.sql: id, file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, chunk_count, status, error_message, embedding_model, collection_name, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_document (file_name, file_type, file_size, file_path, chunk_count, status, embedding_model, collection_name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{filePath}, 0, #{status}, #{embeddingModel}, #{collectionName}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM qa_document ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_document SET status = 'INDEXED', chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE qa_document SET embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, collection_name = #{collectionName}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT embedding_model FROM qa_document WHERE embedding_model IS NOT NULL
SELECT FROM qa_document ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT FROM qa_document WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PARSING', 'FAILED') ORDER BY id ASC
